rules.description: Avoid hyperbole and empty buzzwords such as 'ninja', 'rockstar', 'synergy', or 'crush it'.

positive: Build a campaign that helps your small business succeed.
negative: Become a marketing ninja and crush it with synergy!

rules.description: Do not use directional or device-specific link language such as 'click here' or 'see above'.

positive: Read the automation guide to configure triggers.

rules.description: Write 'email' without a hyphen (never 'e-mail') and 'website' as one word (never 'web site').

positive: Send your first email campaign from your website.
negative: Send your first e-mail campaign from your web site.

test_pieces.piece_text: Become a marketing ninja and crush it with your next campaign!
Send an e-mail to your subscribers. Click here to start.
Schedule your email newsletter and review audience insights from your dashboard.
